abelianization_core.recovery: This D8 is recovered directly from the cocycle and agrees with the independent D8 ingredient in the stabilizer fiber-product certificate.

claim_boundary: The 576 and 1728 counts are exact consequences of the certified cocycle formula.
The D8 identification is structural, using the restricted extension multiplication and element-order spectrum, not order alone.
Matches to Latin-square counts or hardware ledgers remain bridge targets until an explicit equivariant dictionary is built.
The parity carry is a finite group-cohomology obstruction; no Spin/Pin or fermionic phase interpretation is asserted.

count_bridges.1728: Untwisted ordered quotient pairs = 1728. This is recorded as a bridge target because 1728 also recurs in Holonet controller ledgers; no canonical identification is asserted here.
count_bridges.576: Cocycle support size 24^2; independently the repo certifies 576 distinct 4x4 Latin squares and multiple order-576 group constructions. Equality of counts alone is not an isomorphism.

headline: The cube-cover 2-cocycle is a rank-one parity carry with exactly 576 twisted pairs. It vanishes on the even A4 sector, and its commutator descends to the nondegenerate symplectic form on C2^2 whose eight-element central lift is D8.

parity_firewall.law: alpha((b,sigma),y)=0 for every y whenever sigma is even
parity_firewall.reading: The local orientation-preserving tetrahedral A4 sector carries no central twist; odd S4 parity is required to activate z.

support_geometry.rank_one_reading: alpha(x,y)=oddParity(x)*antipodalBit(y), so the 48x48 support matrix is an outer product over F2.
